title: Trust and AI in IT Management Decision-Making: A Systematic Review and Framework for Balancing Autonomy with Human Oversight

contributions.purpose: 综述 IT 管理情境下 AI 信任的研究现状
contributions.mechanism: 系统性文献综述(2019–2025),纳入同行评审+行业报告+法规
contributions.evaluation: 综合 21 篇研究/框架/行业报告(定性,无量化指标)
contributions.domain: AI 治理 / IT 管理决策
contributions.source_quote: A systematic literature review (2019–2025) synthesizing 21 peer-reviewed studies, conceptual frameworks, and industry reports.

contributions.purpose: 构建信任因素分类体系
contributions.mechanism: 跨技术/组织/人机交互三维度归纳信任因素
contributions.evaluation: 提出三维信任因素 taxonomy(Figure 1,定性)
contributions.source_quote: A taxonomy of trust factors spanning technical, organizational, and human–AI interaction dimensions (Figure 1).

contributions.purpose: 提供对齐 AI 自主性与监督的操作框架
contributions.mechanism: 2×2 矩阵对齐 AI 自主性与组织信任成熟度
contributions.source_quote: A Trust–Oversight Balance Framework (2×2) to guide IT managers in aligning AI autonomy with organizational trust maturity (Figure 2).

notes: 非实证定性研究,三条贡献 evaluation 均无数字(允许),规模仅 21 篇文献综述。数据红旗:主作者署名为 ChatGPT(GPT-5)与 Perplexity(AI 署名);文献检索自称 exclusively 用 ChatGPT Deep Research 与 Perplexity 完成,无人工数据库核验——存在幻觉/虚构引用的高风险;参考文献多条尾附异常标注 'Open source alternative'。decision=desk-reject。
